full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white fine-art photograph shows a vast, almost empty shoreline at night. The horizon runs low across the middle distance, and a pale full moon glows in a broad misty halo just left of center. A single narrow streetlamp stands a little to its right, rising straight from the dark strip of shore into the brightened sky. Near the base of the lamp, two very small human silhouettes stand or walk close together. Their forms are dark and only lightly resolved, emphasizing the scale of the surrounding space. The foreground is a wide, shallow sheet of water or wet sand, dark at the edges and softly reflective under the moon. Vertical reflections of the lamp and pale sky stretch toward the bottom of the image, wavering and fading into the black surface. The sky itself is graded from luminous gray around the moon to deep charcoal along the top and far sides, with the halo softening any distinct cloud detail. No buildings or other landmarks interrupt the view. The primary light is the diffuse moon glow, with the lamp forming a small precise bright point. Deep shadows swallow the shoreline and make the distant figures read as simple cutout shapes. The camera viewpoint is low and level, keeping the horizon steady and leaving generous dark negative space on both sides of the central lights. Fine grain and soft atmospheric transitions retain photographic realism while allowing the scene to feel slightly uncanny. The composition is quiet and minimal, holding a delicate vertical axis of lamp and reflection inside an immense field of darkness and luminous haze.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白艺术摄影呈现夜晚辽阔、几乎空无一物的海岸。地平线低低横贯中远景，一轮浅亮满月在中央略左的宽阔雾光中发亮。稍右处一盏细高路灯立在深色岸线上，从地面垂直伸入亮起的天空。灯柱附近，两名极小的人形剪影相距很近，似在站立或行走。身形深暗而仅有轻微细节，更衬出周围空间的尺度。前景是一整片浅水或湿沙，边缘深黑，在月光下柔和反光。灯与浅色天空的竖向倒影伸向画面底部，在黑色表面上摇晃并逐渐消散。天空从月亮周围的发光灰色向顶部与远侧的深炭色渐变，光晕柔化了任何明确云层细节。没有房屋或其他地标打断视野。主要光源是漫射的月光，路灯则形成一个小而精确的亮点。深阴影吞没海岸，让远处人物成为简洁的剪影。相机视点低而平，地平线稳定，中央灯光两边都保留大量暗色留白。细颗粒和柔和的空气过渡保有摄影真实感，也让场景略显奇异。构图安静简约，把路灯与倒影的细弱纵轴放进无边黑暗和发亮雾气之中。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white fine-art photography uses extreme tonal restraint: deep charcoal margins, a soft luminous center, and a few crisp dark silhouettes. Atmospheric haze blooms around a round light source, while wet ground returns delicate vertical reflections. A low, steady horizon and wide negative space allow tiny details to carry scale. Light is diffuse and nocturnal, with bright points kept small and shadows allowed to merge. Smooth gradients and fine grain create a dreamlike mood without losing the photograph's spatial credibility. The composition favors one slender vertical anchor, a remote pair of small forms, and a vast quiet field.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白艺术摄影以极克制的色调工作：深炭色边缘、柔和发亮的中央和少数清晰的深色剪影。空气雾气围绕圆形光源泛开，湿润地面返出细弱的竖向倒影。低而稳定的地平线和宽阔留白让微小细节承担尺度。光线漫射而具有夜色，亮点保持小巧，阴影可以相互融合。平滑渐变和细颗粒制造梦境般的情绪，却不损失摄影的空间可信度。构图偏爱一根纤细的竖向锚点、一对远处的小形体和广阔安静的场域。
theme_en: Two tiny figures and a lamppost beneath a glowing moon on a reflective shore
theme_zh: 反光海岸上，两名小人物与路灯立于发亮月亮下
name: Sherry Akrami
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
